description: Scores a set of answers to a Rotate Pilot readiness diagnostic. Returns overall and per-area results (for Part 107 also the score weighted by the official FAA area weights), the areas below the pass mark, the correct answer with explanation for each question, and a suggested next step based on the result.

exam.description: FAA knowledge test: part107 (drone / Remote Pilot, UAG), ppl (Private Pilot Airplane, PAR), ifr (Instrument Rating Airplane, IRA), cpl (Commercial Pilot Airplane, CAX), atp (Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine, ATM).

name: score_diagnostic
title: Score an exam readiness diagnostic
